name: Carboplatin + Paclitaxel every 3 Weeks (TC) for Epithelial Ovarian/Fallopian Tube/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
disease: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancer
histology: epithelial ovarian carcinoma (histology-agnostic backbone; standard for high-grade serous, endometrioid, clear cell, mucinous, and carcinosarcoma). Fallopian tube and primary peritoneal carcinoma are staged and treated as ovarian carcinoma and share this doublet.

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic carboplatin/paclitaxel (TC) backbone is not biomarker restricted. Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 and homologous-recombination-deficiency (HRD) status are tested to guide maintenance PARP inhibitor selection after this primary therapy, not the doublet itself. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer, OV-5 and Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy (OV-D).

lineOfTherapy: first-line primary systemic therapy (adjuvant after primary cytoreductive surgery, or neoadjuvant before interval debulking)

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma requiring primary systemic therapy
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, Principles of Systemic Therapy, Primary Systemic Therapy Regimens (OV-D 6 to 7 of 12)

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel every 3 Weeks (Paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV followed by Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 IV Day 1)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12. PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV on day 1, given before carboplatin, every 21 days. The 3 hr infusion is cross referenced to DeVita 12th ed. line 178646 (paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 3-h infusion every 21 d). Requires corticosteroid and H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
provenance.locator: line 175767 (Carboplatin (AUC 6) + paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 q 3 wk); NCCN OV-D 7 of 12 states Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 IV Day 1

drugs.notes: Source: DeVita 12th ed., line 175767 (target AUC 6). Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026 OV-D 7 of 12 gives the range AUC 5 to 6 IV on day 1, given after paclitaxel. Carboplatin is dosed to target AUC (Calvert formula). Tall man per ISMP. Footnote n (line 2652): due to changes in creatinine methodology, carboplatin dosing may be adjusted per carboplatin dosing guidelines.

regimen.cycles: 3 to 6 cycles; per OV-D footnote m, 6 cycles for stage II to IV disease (and stage I high-grade serous), 3 to 6 cycles for other stage I ovarian cancer types

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling before each dose.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: carboplatin is moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier on the day of treatment.
G-CSF: not routinely required for the every 21 day TC doublet; assess febrile neutropenia risk factors per institutional and NCCN growth factor guidance.

monitoring: renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle for carboplatin AUC dosing
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each cycle for PACLitaxel
infusion reaction monitoring for carboplatin (rising risk with cumulative exposure) and PACLitaxel

doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold or reduce per institutional protocol; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: line 175767 (Carboplatin AUC 6 + paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 q 3 wk); line 178646 (paclitaxel 175 mg/m2 3-h infusion every 21 d)

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, Primary Systemic Therapy Recommended Dosing, Carboplatin/Paclitaxel every 3 Weeks (OV-D 7 of 12); cycle number footnote m (OV-D 7 of 12)

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the every 21 day carboplatin/paclitaxel (TC) doublet, the standard first-line primary systemic therapy for epithelial ovarian carcinoma (StewardMD reference disease ovarian_cancer, subtype #44), including high-grade serous ovarian carcinoma (#45), fallopian tube carcinoma (#46), and primary peritoneal carcinoma (#47), which are staged and treated as ovarian carcinoma and share this doublet plus downstream PARP maintenance. PACLitaxel 175 mg/m2 IV day 1 is grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026 OV-D 7 of 12; the 3 hr infusion is cross referenced to DeVita 12th ed. line 178646. CARBOplatin is dosed to target AUC 6 per DeVita 12th ed. line 175767, with the NCCN range AUC 5 to 6 recorded (OV-D 7 of 12). Cycle number (3 to 6, with 6 for stage II to IV) is per OV-D footnote m. ISMP tall man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
